audit.whatIsWrong: Remove Scurvy was described only as a cleanse; its heal and its 22s rank-1 cooldown were never stated. Cannon Barrage's true damage was absent.
audit.why: Riot text: Remove Scurvy eats citrus to cure crowd control effects AND restore health, 22/20/18/16/14s. Cannon Barrage carries the trueDamage flag, so stacking armour or MR is the wrong answer to it. Powder Keg has no cooldown on placement (0), so 'track Powder Kegs' can only mean deny the barrels, not wait one out — the real timer to track is Remove Scurvy.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now names the 22s Remove Scurvy window; wants.foe[0] adds the heal and Grievous Wounds; dontsFull[1] rewritten onto Cannon Barrage's true damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in either layer mentioned anti-heal timing despite Remove Scurvy's sustain.
audit.why: Missing-interactions rule 'needs-antiheal': Gangplank sustains through chip damage, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
